id: title:Gilbert09:treat exhausted rollbar connection retries as retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and regression protection to Rollbar warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing unnecessary activity restarts.
review.reason: Adds a new method returning transient, recoverable error strings and a parametrized unit test asserting these strings are detected. This provides a bounded correctness and reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion, distinguishing transient failures from permanent ones.
review.uncertainty: The actual recovery behavior and reduction in restarts depend on upstream Temporal and urllib3 implementation, not demonstrated in this patch.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set of transient, recoverable error strings, and adds a test asserting these strings are detected.
observations.code_quote: return {"Max retries exceeded with url", "Rollbar API error (retryable)"}
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Rollbar warehouse ingestion activity to distinguish transient, self-recovering failures from permanent ones, potentially reducing unnecessary activity restarts or permanent failure reporting.

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized unit test checking that the returned retryable error strings are substrings of the observed error messages.
observations.code_quote: assert any(key in observed_error for key in retryable_errors)
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the transient-error classification, though the actual recovery behavior depends on upstream Temporal and urllib3 implementation.
